title: Ronin Rivals
tagline: A web3 turn-based Samurai battle game on Ronin Blockchain, EVM compatible!
description: Ronin Rivals is a turn-based Samurai battle game built on the Ronin blockchain. It's a Web3 game that combines character progression, strategic combat, and blockchain technology to create a persistent, decentralized gaming experience where players own their characters and battle data on-chain.
how_its_made:
Ronin Rivals is built with Next.js 15, Hardhat 3, and integrates the Ronin Tanto Widget for wallet connections. The game features a smart contract written in Solidity that handles all game logic, character progression, and battle mechanics everything on-chain.
The smart contract is deployed on Saigon testnet but it can be deployed on every EVM chain.
